nodes.text:
Sunlight falls on a compact island of Hong Kong streets, suspended against an open blue-sky backdrop above an empty pale-blue void. Roughly twenty tightly packed mid-rise residential and mixed-use buildings gather organically along two narrow streets and their small offset intersection. With no surrounding terrain, the irregular L- or cross-shaped fragment ends abruptly: sidewalks, roads, and buildings meet sheer vertical cut edges, exposing plain building backs.

The neighborhood turns its detailed face inward toward the roads; outward, tall, largely blank walls face the void. Mostly six- to ten-story concrete apartment blocks have flat roofs and muted pink, cream, gray, brown, and green stucco or tile façades, with narrow gaps, varied setbacks, and occasional rounded street corners. Toward the roads, shuttered storefronts, recessed doors, awnings, Chinese and English signs, graffiti, lanterns, and hanging pennant flags form a continuous, cluttered ground-floor strip. Above them, gridded metal-framed windows, enclosed balconies, projecting air-conditioning units, drainpipes, cables, laundry racks, and colorful clothes cover the upper façades.

Yellow curb lines, white lane markings, yellow zebra crossings, small traffic islands, railings, bollards, signs, lamps, hydrants, bins, utility boxes, and manholes fill the inner streets, alongside a fenced orange roadwork area with barriers and cones. On the flat rooftops, corrugated extensions, water or utility housings, railings, antenna frames, satellite dishes, ducts, and small mechanical boxes crowd together.

At the perimeter, the richly detailed, convincingly dense urban core meets an uneven, stark termination of simple wall masses.

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
Sunlight falls on a compact island of Hong Kong streets, suspended against an open blue-sky backdrop above an empty pale-blue void. Roughly twenty tightly packed mid-rise residential and mixed-use buildings gather organically along two narrow streets and their small offset intersection. With no surrounding terrain, the irregular L- or cross-shaped fragment ends abruptly: sidewalks, roads, and buildings meet sheer vertical cut edges, exposing plain building backs.

The neighborhood turns its detailed face inward toward the roads; outward, tall, largely blank walls face the void. Mostly six- to ten-story concrete apartment blocks have flat roofs and muted pink, cream, gray, brown, and green stucco or tile façades, with narrow gaps, varied setbacks, and occasional rounded street corners. Toward the roads, shuttered storefronts, recessed doors, awnings, Chinese and English signs, graffiti, lanterns, and hanging pennant flags form a continuous, cluttered ground-floor strip. Above them, gridded metal-framed windows, enclosed balconies, projecting air-conditioning units, drainpipes, cables, laundry racks, and colorful clothes cover the upper façades.

Yellow curb lines, white lane markings, yellow zebra crossings, small traffic islands, railings, bollards, signs, lamps, hydrants, bins, utility boxes, and manholes fill the inner streets, alongside a fenced orange roadwork area with barriers and cones. On the flat rooftops, corrugated extensions, water or utility housings, railings, antenna frames, satellite dishes, ducts, and small mechanical boxes crowd together.

At the perimeter, the richly detailed, convincingly dense urban core meets an uneven, stark termination of simple wall masses.

requirements.source_text: Sunlight falls on a compact island of Hong Kong streets
compact island of Hong Kong streets
suspended against an open blue-sky backdrop
sidewalks, roads, and buildings meet sheer vertical cut edges

The neighborhood turns its detailed face inward toward the roads
outward, tall, largely blank walls face the void
Mostly six- to ten-story concrete apartment blocks
muted pink, cream, gray, brown, and green stucco or tile façades
Toward the roads, shuttered storefronts, recessed doors, awnings, Chinese and English signs, graffiti, lanterns, and hanging pennant flags form a continuous, cluttered ground-floor strip
railings, bollards, signs, lamps, hydrants, bins, utility boxes, and manholes fill the inner streets
alongside a fenced orange roadwork area with barriers and cones
On the flat rooftops, corrugated extensions, water or utility housings, railings, antenna frames, satellite dishes, ducts, and small mechanical boxes crowd together
At the perimeter, the richly detailed, convincingly dense urban core meets an uneven, stark termination of simple wall masses
